description: Create a payment route for a customer. fiat_to_crypto (the default) issues a virtual bank account: fiat deposits convert to a stablecoin and pay out to a wallet, so destinationAddress and destinationPaymentRail are required. Set sourcePaymentRail to 'swift' for a SWIFT collection account: an IBAN that receives international SWIFT transfers, for business customers whose verification is approved and who hold the base_pay_in entitlement; it is not in the customer's name, and settles in USDT on Tron. crypto_to_fiat (an off-ramp route) issues a permanent USDT or USDC deposit address on sourceNetwork: every deposit converts and pays out to one bank account, given as a saved beneficiary (payoutType beneficiary + beneficiaryId) or as bank details. On a crypto_to_fiat route, swiftCode or bicCode is needed only when payoutNetwork is swift. Its deposits are route transactions, read with get_virtual_account_history, never transfers. Deposit handling is set server-side and defaults to auto_payout; change it afterwards with update_virtual_account.

accountHolderName.description: Account holder's full name, or the company name when recipientType is business

accountNumber.description: Bank account number, if not using IBAN

accountType.description: Account type. Required for CAD and USD bank payouts

addressCountry.description: Beneficiary country, ISO 2-letter. The complete address is required for AED, CAD, EUR, GBP, MXN, USD

beneficiaryId.description: crypto_to_fiat with payoutType beneficiary: a saved beneficiary id. Its bank details are copied onto the route; archived beneficiaries are refused

customerId.description: The customer ID to create the payment route for

dateOfBirth.description: Beneficiary date of birth, YYYY-MM-DD. Required when recipientType is individual for AED, CAD, EUR, GBP, MXN, USD

destinationAddress.description: fiat_to_crypto only, required: wallet address deposits are paid out to. Validated against the chosen network

destinationPaymentRail.description: fiat_to_crypto only, required: blockchain network the payout address belongs to

metadata.description: Optional key-value data returned on the route

payIdType.description: PayID alias type. Required when payId is given

payoutNetwork.description: crypto_to_fiat only: how each deposit is paid out. Defaults to the saved beneficiary's payment method, else bank (domestic). swift requires swiftCode or bicCode

payoutType.description: crypto_to_fiat only: pay out to bank details given here, or to a saved beneficiary

purposeCode.description: crypto_to_fiat only: the purpose every payout carries. Required where an off-ramp transfer to the same destination requires one

recipientType.description: Beneficiary type. Required for AED, CAD, EUR, GBP, MXN, USD

sourceCurrency.description: What the customer deposits: a fiat currency for fiat_to_crypto (e.g. 'AUD', 'USD'), or 'USDT' / 'USDC' for crypto_to_fiat

sourceNetwork.description: crypto_to_fiat only, required: the network the deposit address is issued on

sourcePaymentRail.description: fiat_to_crypto only. Omit for the currency's local rail. 'swift' opens a SWIFT collection account (business customers with approved verification and base_pay_in). SWIFT currencies: AED, AUD, CAD, CHF, CZK, DKK, EUR, GBP, GEL, HKD, HUF, JPY, NZD, PLN, SEK, SGD, THB, USD; payout USDT on tron

workflowType.description: fiat_to_crypto: a virtual bank account paying out to a wallet. crypto_to_fiat: a permanent stablecoin address paying out to a bank account

name: create_virtual_account
title: Create payment route
